sources.title: PDF HSRP Number Plate Detection Using Machine Learning
sources.snippet: The model also uses classification to determine whether the number plate is HSRP or non-HSRP. If the number is not HSRP, it is retrieved and forwarded to the user via email with the required information. The accuracy of detection and classification, as well as the efficiency of email communication, demonstrate the system's usefulness.
